ops.name: f_36
ops.prompt:
Close-up bust portrait, framed from just above the hood down to the middle of the chest, the head in the upper third of the frame, the body in a slight three-quarter turn, face toward the camera. Low-key chiaroscuro character portrait: the upper half of his face lies in the deep soft shadow of his hood, his eyes dim and barely visible in the shade with a faint glint; the shadow fades naturally at cheekbone height, and below it his cheeks, jaw, lips and chin are sharply lit by a hard key light from the upper left. Original character art for NEXUS, a near-future professional tactical sport league. The subject is Veil, a professional athlete: a lean, wiry man in his mid thirties with narrow shoulders and a long neck. Gaunt angular lower face, a long narrow jaw, thin lips pressed shut, faint dark stubble, olive matte skin. On his right cheekbone, just below the shadow line, a faint old burn mark: a small area of smooth, slightly paler skin, subtle and fully healed. A slim black competition comms microphone runs along his left jawline. He wears a deep structured hood of heavy stiff grey technical canvas; an internal rod holds its opening as a rigid arch that projects forward beyond his brow. A thin indigo-violet piping follows the inner seam of the hood opening. His overcoat is made of heavy matte charcoal composite panels, a tall stand-up collar and no lapels, open at the front, hanging in straight vertical pleats; underneath, a fitted high-necked graphite-grey athletic compression suit. Behind his right shoulder rise the tops of four slim matte gunmetal canisters standing in a vertical row, each with a thin glowing indigo-violet ring at its joint. Indigo-violet appears only on those rings and the hood piping, nowhere else. The gear is certified competition equipment, lightweight and used: scuffed edges, a stretched shoulder strap, one replacement panel in a slightly different grey. Silent, methodical, still.
Premium competitive video game key art, stylized realism with a subtle painted finish, sharp focus, rich material detail, clean readable silhouette. Hard cool white key light high from the upper left, very dim fill from the right, a thin cool rim light along his contour. Isolated on a plain flat seamless neutral mid-grey studio backdrop with no coloured light on it. No text, no logos, no weapons, no smoke, no mask.
